summary: Automated safeguard/off-ramp request for tenant after mixed-quant + KV-prefetch optimizer change triggered tail latency and intermittent 5xx
description:
Issue summary:
Customer MedAtlas observed a sudden increase in tail-latency (95p/99p) and intermittent 502/504 responses after we deployed a tenant-scoped optimizer profile that enabled mixed-precision quant and aggressive KV-prefetch for throughput. They are on Dedicated capacity and requested an automated off-ramp/safemode script that can be run fast to revert only the optimizer flags for that tenant without a full snapshot restore.

Impact:
- Multiple endpoints for MedAtlas returned elevated 95p latency from ~120ms to ~1.8s and sporadic 502s starting 2026-03-10 13:22 UTC.
- Affects critical inference pipelines for clinical summaries; customer reports degraded UX and paused rollouts.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool medatlas-dedicated-1 (us-east-1)
- Serving runtime v1.32.0
- Recent optimizer profile applied: optimizer-profile-2026-03-10-qprefetch-mixed

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1) Traffic runs normal with baseline profile.
2) Operator applied tenant-scoped profile that set quantization=dynamic-mixed, kv_prefetch=true, batch_target=128.
3) Within ~10 minutes, 95p latency climbs and requests start returning 502/504 from workers that show KV eviction churn in logs.

Observed logs / metrics:
- Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/tenant/medatlas/dashboards/optimizer_telemetry (95p spike)
- Sample worker log: "kv_cache: eviction_count=1725 in_last_60s; kv_prefetch_queue_full=true"
- Router logs: elevated upstream 502s with timeout traces to serving runtime containers.

Customer ask:
- Provide a safe, tested script (or playbook) that toggles a per-tenant safemode which:
  * Disables kv_prefetch for tenant traffic
  * Lowers batch_target to conservative value (e.g., 8)
  * Reverts quantization to per-model baseline (int8 fallback) for affected tenant only
  * Optionally drains and restarts a small subset of serving workers for the tenant without taking entire pool offline
- Steps to validate the off-ramp and rollback without impacting other tenants on the same dedicated pool.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 13:40 UTC - Initial triage by support: confirmed tail latency and 502s; notified SRE; customer provided traffic window and baseline config.
2026-03-10 14:05 UTC - Captured heap/KV metrics from medatlas-dedicated-1 workers; eviction_count correlated with the onset of 502s.

Hypothesis: aggressive kv_prefetch combined with mixed-precision quantization increased memory churn and forced frequent KV evictions, which caused cache misses and long downstream kernel latencies under heavy batching pressure.
Rolling down batch_target and disabling kv_prefetch for tenant improved synthetic test in staging (reduced 95p by ~60%).

Risk notes: global profile changes would affect other tenants; need per-tenant toggle. Existing 'optimizer-toggle' endpoint supports tenant flags but lacks an automated multi-step off-ramp script that also adjusts batch settings and drains safely.
Suggested immediate action: prepare a script that atomically sets per-tenant flags and performs targeted worker drain with health-check gating.
comments: Support - Aisha Patel (2026-03-10 13:50 UTC): Acknowledged. Escalating to SRE. Collecting logs and time window.
SRE - Eleni Morgan (2026-03-10 14:12 UTC): Observed KV eviction spikes. Reproduced symptom in small staging cluster. Will draft off-ramp steps and safety checks.
Customer - Rajesh Kumar (MedAtlas) (2026-03-10 14:30 UTC): This is blocking deployment. Please provide something we can run quickly; prefer tenant-scoped change only.
Support - Tomás Rivera (2026-03-11 09:05 UTC): Drafted preliminary safemode script (internal link). Requesting review from runtime team and SRE. CI smoke tests run attached to PR.

Runtime Eng - Priya Shah (2026-03-11 12:40 UTC): Reviewed script. Minor change: add backoff and verify KV eviction rate drops below threshold before completing. Also ensure quant revert uses tenant pin to baseline model artifact.
Support - Tomás Rivera (2026-03-12 08:22 UTC): Prepared customer-facing playbook and one-line command to toggle safemode via admin API. Scheduling maintenance window with customer for controlled run.
resolution: Workaround prepared: one-line admin API command and safemode script that disables kv_prefetch, sets batch_target=8 for tenant, and reverts quant to int8 baseline. Script includes health checks (95p latency and kv_eviction thresholds) and a safe drain/restart for up to 2 workers at a time. Scheduled controlled run with MedAtlas for 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC. Post-change monitoring plan defined; full rollback playbook added to Confluence. Follow-up: add a test to CI to validate per-tenant optimizer toggles and add an automated canary gate for future optimizer profile rollouts.
